_comment: Illustrative placeholder ground control points for the synthetic demo map only - not a real survey. Loosely centred on Lucknow for continuity with sample_01/03's Narharpur village, not a claim about its real location.
_village_comment: The village this map covers. Parcel-to-document matching is scoped to it so two villages that reuse the same khasra numbers cannot cross-match.
